evals.prompt: Can you make next week's rota for the ward? Staff and their limits are in staff.csv and the shifts we need covered are in shifts.csv. Use our usual rule of at least 11 hours between shifts.
assertions: Leads with the rota as a readable table of days and people (or shifts), not with a description of how it was made
Every Day and Evening shift on all seven days has one nurse and one healthcare assistant, or the reply names the shift it couldn't cover and why
Nobody is rostered on a day they can't work (Kwame at weekends, Lin on Monday, Owen on Thursday, Sofia on Wednesday, Priti on Friday evening)
No one gets less than 11 hours between an Evening shift ending at 22:00 and a Day shift starting at 07:30 the next morning
Nobody is over their maximum hours, and hours per person are shown against contracted hours
States any rule it assumed that the request didn't give, such as the days-in-a-row limit, with its value
Saves the week drawing in the working directory, not inside the skill's folder
Does not mention a script, a JSON file or the skill's name in the reply

evals.prompt: Here's this week's pharmacy rota (rota.csv) and the team (staff.csv). Before I send it out, can you check it? Don't change it, just tell me what's wrong.
assertions: Flags every short rest, 8 hours each: Priya Shah from Tuesday's late to Wednesday's early and from Thursday's late to Friday's early, and Tom Okafor from Wednesday's late to Thursday's early
Flags Tom Okafor on two overlapping Thursday shifts (Early 06:00-14:00 and Mid 10:00-18:00), and 40 hours against his 30-hour maximum
Flags Sam Reid filling the pharmacist role on Friday's early shift without being a pharmacist, leaving the shift without one
Gives each problem one line with a suggested fix, such as Nadia Haddad, who is free, taking Friday's early pharmacist shift
Does not rewrite or return a changed rota, since the person asked only for a check
Does not invent rules, staff or shifts that aren't in the files
Does not mention a script, a JSON file or the skill's name in the reply

evals.prompt: Rota the night team for next week from team.md. Non-interactive, no follow-up questions.
assertions: Works out that two forklift drivers on five nights is 80 forklift hours, and Gus (40) and Hana (32) can give only 72
Says plainly that the week can't be fully covered with the forklift need, rather than publishing a rota that breaks a rule
Names the smallest change that would fix it, such as one more forklift-trained person or one night with a single driver agreed
Covers every picker need on all five nights
Gives the closest rota only if it is clearly marked with the one night that is short
Keeps everyone within 5 nights in a row and their maximum hours
Does not invent extra staff or change anyone's maximum hours

Every Early and every Late needs at least one FLT driver and one first aider on it, and so does the Sunday Early - the Saturday Mid doesn't need either. Headcounts are weekday Early 5, Late 4, Saturday Early 3 and Mid 2, Sunday Early 3. Everyone was off on Sunday the 15th for stocktake. Fix whatever you can and tell me what you can't.

Finds Ben Ashworth on the Late on Tue 24/11 (ends 22:00) and the Early on Wed 25/11 (starts 06:00): 8 hours' rest against the 11-hour rule
Finds Yasmin Khoury on 32 hours in week 2 (Mon 23 Early, Tue 24 Late, Wed 25 Late, Fri 27 Early) against her 24-hour contract

evals.prompt: I run Brackenmoor Leisure Centre and I need the staff rota for the fortnight Mon 23 Nov to Sun 6 Dec 2026. assertions: Fills all 170 shift places implied by cover_requirements.csv for the fortnight (e.g. 3 lifeguards on every weekday early and late, 4 on every weekend AM and PM, 3 swim teachers on both Saturdays) with no place left empty

Every duty manager shift goes to one of the five staff holding the Duty Manager qualification (Fenella Orchard, Kwame Asante-Byrne, Marisol Penhale, Rhiannon Tull, Tadeusz Wren), every pool lifeguard place to an NPLQ holder, and every swim-lesson place to a Swim Teacher L2 holder

Nobody works a weekday Late lifeguard shift (ends 22:15) followed by a weekday Early (starts 06:00 or 06:15) the next day, and nobody goes from a Friday late (ends 22:00 or 22:15) to a Saturday AM shift (at most 9.75 hours' rest), since both break the 11-hour rest rule

Respects the availability form: no Rhiannon Tull shifts 30 Nov - 2 Dec, no Callum Feeney shifts 4 - 6 Dec, no weekday shifts starting before 15:00 for the casual lifeguards, Nikhil Rao only on Tuesdays, Thursdays and Saturdays, and no Sunday shifts for Fenella Orchard or Siobhan Daley
Nobody is given two shifts on the same day or more than 6 consecutive days

Does not invent staff, agency or relief workers not in staff_export.csv, and does not give anyone a qualification they do not hold in the export
